holidayOverlay.note: Official website closures are an explicit overlay, not present in the GTFS calendar_dates file.

conflicts.description: Official GTFS and official PDF publish differing timetable values. GTFS times are retained verbatim; no provider confirmation has resolved the discrepancy. Results must require confirmation.

license: No explicit redistribution license found in the downloaded GTFS snapshot. Attribute BTD; this is not a license grant.
projection: Only six selected Route 00 Orange stops are retained, preserving original stop order and exact minute times. Not the entire route or network.
walkingReview: Stop coordinates come from GTFS; they do not establish reviewed pedestrian routes.
minTransferMinutesNote: Five-minute planning margin, not a published guaranteed connection.
